title: All Skinfolk Ain't Kinfolk: Children of Darkness
body:
IUIC in the ClassRoom · 2026-01-03

Opens [Rom 9](/bible/romans/9) · [Ezra 4](/bible/ezra/4) · [Neh 2](/bible/nehemiah/2) · [Neh 9](/bible/nehemiah/9) · [1 Macc 3](/bible/1-maccabees/3) · [Eccl 7](/bible/ecclesiastes/7) · [Isa 28](/bible/isaiah/28) · [Hos 4](/bible/hosea/4) · [Mic 2](/bible/micah/2) · [Neh 6](/bible/nehemiah/6) · [Neh 13](/bible/nehemiah/13) · [2 Macc 4](/bible/2-maccabees/4) · [John 8](/bible/john/8) · [Mark 3](/bible/mark/3) · [Isa 29](/bible/isaiah/29) · [Acts 7](/bible/acts/7) · and 4 more below
## Introduction *[[8:37](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=517s)]* The title means that not everyone who shares Israel's skin shares its spirit. Paul grieved for his kinsmen according to the flesh, yet many Israelites will not make it. Some have a house-servant spirit that wants the enemy to share in Israel's salvation and fights for the heathen to rule over them. The class follows the pattern from the adversaries who tried to join the temple building to the ungodly Israelites of the Maccabees, the Herodians and the rulers who said 'we have no king but Caesar.' It closes with Christ's warnings that many are called but few chosen, and that the builders who rejected the stone will be ground to powder. ## In The News - *[[22:11](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=1331s)]* **A film scene in which a Black businessman who wants to build his own community is told by the Italian families that they will take half.** — Whenever Israel tries to build for itself, Esau demands a share or destroys it, as with Seneca Village and Black Bottom. - *[[35:31](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=2131s)]* **A scene from Judas and the Black Messiah in which the FBI tells its informant that killing Fred Hampton works better than jailing him.** — The FBI neutralized movements through informants inside. The same spirit mocks Israel today. - *[[48:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=2932s)]* **A film scene in which a house servant boasts that he eats the master's food and calls the field workers victims, and another in which white men say they must raise the smart Black man among them to neutralize his racial anger.** — Creature comforts turn Israelites into the enemy's tools. Except for his colour, he has become one of them. - *[[1:36:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=5808s)]* **A scene from 12 Years a Slave in which a captive who wanted to fight is killed while the others keep silent.** — The apologetics who defend the master are the same spirit today. - *[[1:40:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=6059s)]* **An explainer on the Herodians, Jews who supported Herod and Roman rule for political stability.** — Today's Herodians are athletes, entertainers and content creators who side with the oppressor for money and mock Israel. ## Scriptures Opened **[Romans 9:3](/bible/romans/9#v3)** *[[10:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=624s)]* > [3](/bible/romans/9#v3) For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh: - Paul could wish himself accursed for his kinsmen according to the flesh, to whom pertain the adoption, the covenants, the law and the promises. - All skinfolk are not kinfolk. Many Israelites are heathen in spirit and will not make it. **[Ezra 4:1](/bible/ezra/4#v1)** *[[12:40](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=760s)]* > [1](/bible/ezra/4#v1) Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the Lord God of Israel; - The adversaries of Judah said, let us build with you, for we seek your God. Zerubbabel answered, ye have nothing to do with us. - Israelites with a house-servant spirit want to find the enemy a place in Israel's salvation. Israel will build alone. Precepts: - **[1 Esdras 5:73](/bible/1-esdras/5#v73)** > [73](/bible/1-esdras/5#v73) And by their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building all the time that king Cyrus lived: so they were hindered from building for the space of two years, until the reign of Darius. By their secret plots and popular persuasions and commotions they hindered the finishing of the building. **[Nehemiah 2:10](/bible/nehemiah/2#v10)** *[[32:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=1954s)]* > [10](/bible/nehemiah/2#v10) When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel. - Sanballat and Tobiah were grieved that a man came to seek the welfare of the children of Israel. - Informants within have always destroyed movements, as when the Black Panthers let others in. **[Nehemiah 9:30](/bible/nehemiah/9#v30)** *[[37:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=2224s)]* > [30](/bible/nehemiah/9#v30) Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands. - Many years God testified by his prophets, yet they would not give ear; therefore he gave them into the hand of the people of the lands. - They have dominion over our bodies and cattle at their pleasure. Israel is the cause of its own condition. **[1 Maccabees 3:43](/bible/1-maccabees/3#v43)** *[[44:23](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=2663s)]* > [43](/bible/1-maccabees/3#v43) They said one to another, Let us restore the decayed fortune of our people, and let us fight for our people and the sanctuary. - Every age raised brethren who sought the welfare of their people and the sanctuary: Mordecai, Mattathias and his sons. Precepts: - **[Deuteronomy 28:33](/bible/deuteronomy/28#v33)** > [33](/bible/deuteronomy/28#v33) The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway: The fruit of thy land shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes. **[Ecclesiastes 7:7](/bible/ecclesiastes/7#v7)** *[[48:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=2932s)]* > [7](/bible/ecclesiastes/7#v7) Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart. - Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad. The house servant is not mad, because he loves his comforts. **[Isaiah 28:15](/bible/isaiah/28#v15)** *[[59:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=3545s)]* > [15](/bible/isaiah/28#v15) Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves: - We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us. They think their comforts will save them. **[Hosea 4:1](/bible/hosea/4#v1)** *[[1:06:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=3977s)]* > [1](/bible/hosea/4#v1) Hear the word of the Lord, ye children of Israel: for the Lord hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land. - There is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land. Evil was among Israel before the white man; it only multiplied under him. Precepts: - **[1 Maccabees 11:21](/bible/1-maccabees/11#v21)** > [21](/bible/1-maccabees/11#v21) Then came ungodly persons, who hated their own people, went unto the king, and told him that Jonathan besieged the tower, Certain ungodly persons, who hated their own people, went unto the king. - **[Ezekiel 7:20](/bible/ezekiel/7#v20)** > [20](/bible/ezekiel/7#v20) As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them. I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth. **[Micah 2:8](/bible/micah/2#v8)** *[[1:12:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=4330s)]* > [8](/bible/micah/2#v8) Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war. - Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely. Israel robs Israel today as then. **[Nehemiah 6:10](/bible/nehemiah/6#v10)** *[[1:13:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=4386s)]* > [10](/bible/nehemiah/6#v10) Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee. - Shemaiah urged Nehemiah to hide in the temple, but he had been hired by Tobiah and Sanballat to make Nehemiah afraid and give them matter for an evil report. - Should such a man as I flee? Leaders will be targeted by brethren paid to defame them. **[Nehemiah 13:23](/bible/nehemiah/13#v23)** *[[1:15:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=4541s)]* > [23](/bible/nehemiah/13#v23) In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab: - Jews married wives of Ashdod, and their children could not speak the Jews' language. The mother is the first teacher. - Nehemiah contended with them and cleansed the priesthood from all strangers. **[2 Maccabees 4:1](/bible/2-maccabees/4#v1)** *[[1:21:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=4911s)]* > [1](/bible/2-maccabees/4#v1) This Simon now, of whom we spake afore, having been a betrayer of the money, and of his country, slandered Onias, as if he had terrified Heliodorus, and been the worker of these evils. - Jason brought in Greek fashions and a place of exercise, and the priests left the altar to watch the games, liking the glory of the Grecians best of all. - Menelaus outbid him for the priesthood, and Jason turned and slew his own people. The seekers of the white man's glory do the same today. Precepts: - **[2 Maccabees 10:20](/bible/2-maccabees/10#v20)** > [20](/bible/2-maccabees/10#v20) Now they that were with Simon, being led with covetousness, were persuaded for money through certain of those that were in the castle, and took seventy thousand drachms, and let some of them escape. Those with Simon were persuaded for money to let the enemy go, and Judas slew the traitors. **[John 8:31](/bible/john/8#v31)** *[[1:32:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=5532s)]* > [31](/bible/john/8#v31) Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed; - Ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free. They answered, we were never in bondage. Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin. Precepts: - **[John 11:48](/bible/john/11#v48)** > [48](/bible/john/11#v48) If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation. If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him, and the Romans shall come and take away our place and nation. - **[John 19:15](/bible/john/19#v15)** > [15](/bible/john/19#v15) But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cesar. We have no king but Caesar. **[Mark 3:6](/bible/mark/3#v6)** *[[1:40:09](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=6009s)]* > [6](/bible/mark/3#v6) And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him. - The Pharisees took counsel with the Herodians how they might destroy him. Precepts: - **[Psalms 2:2](/bible/psalms/2#v2)** > [2](/bible/psalms/2#v2) The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed, saying, The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord and against his anointed. - **[Luke 21:12](/bible/luke/21#v12)** > [12](/bible/luke/21#v12) But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name’s sake. Ye shall be brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake. **[Isaiah 29:9](/bible/isaiah/29#v9)** *[[1:52:40](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=6760s)]* > [9](/bible/isaiah/29#v9) Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink. - They are drunken, but not with wine; the Lord hath closed your eyes, the prophets and seers hath he covered. Precepts: - **[Psalms 118:22](/bible/psalms/118#v22)** > [22](/bible/psalms/118#v22) The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner. The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner. - **[Psalms 69:22](/bible/psalms/69#v22)** > [22](/bible/psalms/69#v22) Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap. Let their table become a snare before them, and let their eyes be darkened. - **[2 Chronicles 36:16](/bible/2-chronicles/36#v16)** > [16](/bible/2-chronicles/36#v16) But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the Lord arose against his people, till there was no remedy. They mocked the messengers of God and misused his prophets, till there was no remedy. **[Acts 7:51](/bible/acts/7#v51)** *[[1:56:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=7012s)]* > [51](/bible/acts/7#v51) Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye. - Ye stiffnecked, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye. Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? **[Jude 1:6](/bible/jude/1#v6)** *[[1:59:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=7191s)]* > [6](/bible/jude/1#v6) And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day. - The angels which kept not their first estate are reserved in everlasting chains under darkness. The sons of God who took the daughters of men were Israelites who fell into fornication. Precepts: - **[Genesis 6:2](/bible/genesis/6#v2)** > [2](/bible/genesis/6#v2) That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose. The sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair. - **[2 Peter 2:4](/bible/2-peter/2#v4)** > [4](/bible/2-peter/2#v4) For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment; God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down and delivered them into chains of darkness. **[Luke 16:14](/bible/luke/16#v14)** *[[2:02:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=7369s)]* > [14](/bible/luke/16#v14) And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him. - The covetous Pharisees derided him. Ye are they which justify yourselves before men, but that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God. Precepts: - **[Isaiah 43:6](/bible/isaiah/43#v6)** > [6](/bible/isaiah/43#v6) I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth; Bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth. **[Luke 20:9](/bible/luke/20#v9)** *[[2:05:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=7543s)]* > [9](/bible/luke/20#v9) Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time. - The husbandmen beat the servants and killed the beloved son; the lord of the vineyard will destroy them and give the vineyard to others. - Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken, but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder. Precepts: - **[Jude 1:8](/bible/jude/1#v8)** > [8](/bible/jude/1#v8) Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities. These filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities. **[Matthew 22:14](/bible/matthew/22#v14)** *[[2:11:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=7885s)]* > [14](/bible/matthew/22#v14) For many are called, but few are chosen. - The king sent his servants to call the bidden to the wedding, and they slew them; he destroyed those murderers and burned their city. Many are called, but few are chosen. ## Class Questions - **What does 'all skinfolk ain't kinfolk' mean in scripture?** Not all Israel is of Israel (Romans 9:6). Many Israelites have the spirit of the enemy and will not make it, though the promises pertain to the nation. - **Why did Zerubbabel refuse help from the adversaries?** They wanted to share in the building to hinder it, and after being refused they used secret plots and persuasions to stop it (Ezra 4; 1 Esdras 5). - **Who were the Herodians?** Jews who supported Herod and Roman rule, who joined the Pharisees to destroy Christ (Mark 3:6). The class compares them to those who defend the oppressor today. - **Why did Nehemiah call Shemaiah a false prophet?** He was hired by Tobiah and Sanballat to frighten Nehemiah into hiding so they could defame him (Nehemiah 6:10–13). - **What does Christ say about the builders who reject the stone?** Whoever falls on it shall be broken, but on whomever it falls it will grind him to powder (Luke 20:18). ## In Closing *[[2:18:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw&t=8287s)]* Many of our people are called, but few will be chosen. Do not be a Herodian or a house servant; build with your own and be found in a wedding garment. --- [Class Notes Index](/classes) · [Watch the full session on YouTube ↗](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7JMsDMvuXw)
